mapper.select: select c.id,c.content,c.user_id,c.created_time,c.like_count, u.username,u.avatar,c.reply_count as childCount from comment c left join user u on c.user_id = u.id where c.id = #{targetId} and c.status = 1

select c.id,c.content,c.user_id,c.created_time,c.like_count, u.username,u.avatar,c.reply_count as childCount from comment c left join user u on c.user_id = u.id where c.target_id = #{targetId} and c.parent_id=0 and c.status = 1 order by c.created_time desc
select count(1) from comment where parent_id = #{targetId} and id < #{lastId} and status = 1
select count(1) from comment where target_id = #{targetId} and parent_id=0 and id < #{lastId} and status = 1
